VIPERC 2023
Visual Pattern Extraction and Recognition for Cultural Heritage Understanding 2023


Proceedings of the 2nd International Satellite Conference on Visual Pattern Extraction and Recognition for Cultural Heritage Understanding
co-located with 27th International Conference on Theory and Practice of Digital Libraries (TPDL 2023)

Zadar, Croatia, September 25-26, 2023.


Edited by

Alessia Amelio *
Francesco Cauteruccio **
Domenico Ursino **
Luca Virgili **

* University "G. d'Annunzio" Chieti-Pescara, InGeo, 65127 Pescara, Italy
** Marche Polytechnic University, DII, 60131 Ancona, Italy




Table of Contents

  • Preface
    Summary: There were 11 papers submitted for peer-review to this conference. Out of these, 5 papers were accepted for this volume, 5 as regular papers

Session 1: 25 September 2023 (Chair: Dr. Valentino Sangiorgio)

  • Steps in building a transcription technology: deciphering the content of historical romanian documents
    Petru Rebeja, Eduard Coman, Claudiu Marinescu, Dan Cristea
  • On the innovative forms of communication in forensic engineering: the italian contest
    Regina Finocchiaro, Samuele Biondi, Franco Bontempi
  • Deep learning empowered classification of augmented cultural heritage images
    Israr Ur Rehman, Zulfiqar Ali, Zahoor Jan, Muhammad Rashid, Ali Abbas, Nadeem Tariq

Session 2: 26 September 2023 (Chair: Dr. Alessia Amelio)

  • AI-driven image generation for enhancing design in digital fabrication: urban furnishings in historic city centres
    Giuseppe Fallacara, Maria Pia Fanti, Fabio Parisi, Nicola Parisi, Valentino Sangiorgio
  • People-centred natural language processing for cultural tourism market: a research agenda
    Mohamed W. Fareed, Mohamed Amer
